purpose: Create append-only security audit records and idempotency receipts with database-enforced mutation rejection.
lockImpact: Creates a new module-owned schema, tables, indexes, function, triggers, and grants only; no existing application table is rewritten or locked.
dataImpact: Creates empty audit structures. No inferred log facts, identities, permissions, or business data are inserted.
backfill: Not required. Existing logs are intentionally not converted into audit facts.
recovery: Roll back the application while retaining audit evidence. Restore a pre-migration recovery point only before records are accepted; never drop populated audit history.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed audit-owned migration. Existing audit records and this migration remain immutable.
